name: HelpDesk.com
description_en:
HelpDesk.com is a ticketing product and the current signup entry for Text, its parent company’s broader AI customer-service platform. Existing HelpDesk accounts remain available without a required migration. New signups receive Text with ticketing, live chat, AI and additional channels; those account cohorts should not be evaluated as one unchanged feature set.

For an email-support evaluation, trace inbound forwarding, customer-facing reply addresses, ownership and repeated automation events. Match the price to the actual product and account rather than combining legacy Team/Business documentation with current Essential/Growth offers. This profile is based on public documentation, with no account or message execution.
description_zh:
HelpDesk.com 是工单产品，也是当前通往其母公司更广泛 AI 客服平台 Text 的注册入口。既有 HelpDesk 账户继续可用，不要求迁移。新注册获得包含工单、在线聊天、AI 及额外渠道的 Text；不能将这些账户群体当成一套始终不变的功能。

评估邮件支持时，应追踪入站转发、客户看到的回复地址、归属及重复自动化事件。价格需对应实际产品和账户，不能把旧 Team／Business 文档与当前 Essential／Growth 方案混合。本文基于公开文档，未执行账户或消息测试。

faq.question_en: Must existing HelpDesk customers migrate to Text?
faq.question_zh: 既有 HelpDesk 客户必须迁移到 Text 吗？
faq.answer_en: No. The current about page says existing accounts continue. New helpdesk.com signups instead create a Text account.
faq.answer_zh: 不必，当前关于页称既有账户继续可用；helpdesk.com新注册则建立Text账户。

faq.question_en: Does domain verification deliver incoming email?
faq.question_zh: 验证域名就能收邮件吗？
faq.answer_en: No. Forwarding must also be configured at the email provider. Legacy instructions warn that replies will be missed without forwarding from the reply address.
faq.answer_zh: 不能，还需在邮件服务商配置转发。旧版说明警告，不从回复地址转发会漏掉客户回复。

official_check.scope: Public vendor documentation reviewed; no account execution, purchase, owner identity, independent review or publication approval.

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.
English and Chinese are paired drafts. Chinese text does not establish Chinese UI support.
All alternative relationships remain unreviewed. Public-web retrieval may use cached content; prices are dated observations.

sections.title_en: Choose the account cohort before comparing features
sections.title_zh: 比较功能前先确定账户群体
sections.en:
HelpDesk.com now presents Text to new visitors. Its about page explicitly says a new signup starts a Text trial with ticketing, live chat, AI and revenue features. Existing standalone HelpDesk customers can keep their current accounts and do not have to migrate. Text is both the parent company name and a platform name.

A legacy screenshot or rule tutorial is evidence for that documented workflow, not proof the new platform has identical settings. When comparing vendors, record the actual account product, selected plan and channel scope. Published resolution percentages, revenue figures and security labels are vendor statements rather than independent outcomes or audited guarantees in this research.
sections.zh:
HelpDesk.com现在面向新访客展示Text。关于页明确表示，新注册启动含工单、聊天、AI及收入功能的Text试用。既有独立HelpDesk客户可继续当前账户，无须迁移。Text既是母公司名称，也是平台名称。

旧截图或规则教程只能证明文档中的流程，不能证明新平台设置相同。比较厂商时应记录实际账户产品、所选套餐和渠道范围。公开解决率、收入数据及安全标签属于厂商陈述，本研究未独立验证结果或审计保证。

sections.title_en: Verify both delivery and reply identity
sections.title_zh: 同时验证投递与回复身份
sections.en:
Current email setup instructions distinguish Text from older HelpDesk. In Text, a provider forwards messages to the account’s ticket address; a test email should appear in the inbox. A branded reply domain requires administrative access to DNS and verification records. Connected, confirming, incomplete and failed states are documented, so configuring records alone is not evidence of success.

In the older workflow, domain verification and inbound forwarding are separate. The guide specifically warns that customer responses will not arrive unless the reply address forwards to HelpDesk. For an illustrative support mailbox, test a new request, an agent reply and the customer’s response, then inspect the displayed sender and assigned team. No DNS or mailbox was changed here.
sections.zh:
当前邮件设置说明区分Text和旧HelpDesk。Text由邮件服务商转发至账户工单地址，测试邮件应出现在收件箱。品牌回复域需要DNS管理权限及验证记录。文档列已连接、验证中、不完整和失败状态，因此填入记录不能证明成功。

旧流程中，域名验证与入站转发是两件事。指南明确警告，回复地址若未转发至HelpDesk，就收不到客户回应。以假设支持邮箱为例，应测试新请求、坐席回复及客户再次回应，再检查显示发件人和所分团队。此次未修改DNS或邮箱。

sections.title_en: Inspect repeated events in the documented rule engine
sections.title_zh: 检查文档规则引擎中的重复事件
sections.en:
The legacy HelpDesk rule guide says ticket creation and later ticket changes trigger condition checks. Rules run in creation order, combine ALL or ANY conditions and can execute multiple actions such as assignment, status, tags, notes or messages. Duplicating a rule places its copy at the bottom. Conditions that match a substring differ from phrase matching and case-sensitive variants.

A separate advanced guide says a rule normally executes once per ticket unless it qualifies as safe: ALL needs at least one safe condition, whereas ANY needs every condition to be safe. The time-passed exception refers to an image/table not recovered as text, so its exact formula remains unverified. Pilot repeated changes before sending automatic replies; these tutorials do not establish identical behavior in Text.
sections.zh:
旧HelpDesk规则指南称，创建工单及后续变更都会触发条件检查。规则按创建顺序执行，可组合ALL或ANY条件，并执行分配、状态、标签、备注、消息等多个动作。复制规则会放到末尾。子串匹配、短语匹配及区分大小写版本含义不同。

另一高级指南称，每条规则通常每工单只执行一次，符合安全条件才例外：ALL至少有一个安全条件，ANY则全部条件都须安全。“经过时间”例外引用未提取为文字的图表，准确公式未核实。发送自动回复前应试验重复变更；这些教程不能证明Text行为完全相同。

sections.title_en: Price new Text seats and AI usage together
sections.title_zh: 共同计算新Text席位与AI用量
sections.en:
The current page lists Essential at $19 per user/month billed annually or $25 monthly, and Growth at $79 annually or $99 monthly. Enterprise is quoted. Monthly AI-resolution allowances are ten and two hundred respectively; extra resolutions auto-refill in fifty-packs costing $49.50. Annual invoices charge twelve months upfront. The published trial is fourteen days without a credit card. Dollar symbols are shown, but a currency code was not established here.

The page advertises unlimited tickets, not unlimited AI or all activity. Its FAQ first describes extra AI resolutions as the only usage-based charge, then separately mentions workflow execution allowances and top-ups. Resolve that meter and the exact definition of a billable resolution in the selected order before a volume projection. AI language coverage does not establish a translated administrator interface.
sections.zh:
当前页Essential每人每月年付折月$19或月付$25，Growth年付折月$79或月付$99，Enterprise询价。每月AI解决额度分别10与200次，额外以50次$49.50自动补充。年付一次收12个月费用，公开试用为14天免卡。页面显示美元符号，但此处未确认币种代码。

页面宣传无限工单，不代表无限AI或所有活动。FAQ先说额外AI解决是唯一用量费，之后又提工作流执行额度及补充。按量预测前应在所选订单澄清该计量及收费解决定义。AI语言覆盖不表示管理员界面已翻译。

sections.title_en: Keep legacy Team and Business in their own comparison
sections.en:
The older plan guide lists Team from $29 per agent/month annually and Business from $50 annually. Team includes up to five active rules and five viewers; Business lists fifty active rules and twenty viewers. Business permits unlimited paid users, which is not free unlimited agents. Its account billing is based on the subscribed seat quantity: deleting an agent does not automatically reduce that quantity.

These legacy prices and limits should not replace the current Essential/Growth signup offer or be treated as a lower or higher tier within it. An existing-account owner should first check the actual subscription, renewal and migration options. Export completeness, recovery, legal license terms, precise regions, full UI languages and channel-provider fees were not verified; no migration, account purchase or automation was executed.
sections.zh:
旧套餐指南列Team年付折月每坐席$29起，Business年付折月$50起。Team最多5条活动规则及5名查看者，Business列50条活动规则及20名查看者。Business可有无限付费用户，不是无限免费坐席。账户按所订席位数量计费，删除坐席不会自动降低该数量。

这些旧价及限制不能替代当前Essential／Growth注册方案，也不能当成同系列较低或较高档。既有账户负责人应先检查实际订阅、续约及迁移选项。导出完整性、恢复、法律许可、准确地区、完整界面语言及渠道服务商费未核实；此次未执行迁移、购买或自动化。
